definitions.short: Kir , a place in Assyrian; also one in Moab
definitions.full: H7024. Qiyr II. קִיר in proper name, of a location of Moabite cities (compare קר = city MI 11, 12, 24 , plural קרן Jeremiah 1:29); — ᵐ5 usually omitted, or reads τὸ τεῖχος ; — 1 ׳ק מוֺאָב Isa 15:1 , possibly Rabba , south of Arnon, see Buhl Geogr.270. 2 ׳ק חֶ֫רֶשׂ Jer 48:31 , 36 , ׳ק חָ֑רֶשׂ Isa 16:11 = ׳ק חֲרֶ֫שֶׂת 16:7 , ׳ק חֲדָ֑שֶׂת 2Kin 3:25 (Gi ׳ק חֲרָ֑שֶׁת ), perhaps Kerak , south of Rabba, see Buhl lb., and compare (on Kerak) Palmer Des. of Exodus 2.472 Dowling PEQ. Oct. 1896, 327 , especially Mauss in de Luynes Voyage à la Mer Morte (1864), ii. 106 ff., iii (Atlas, near the end), 13 plural III. קִיר proper name, of a territory or people ׳ק original house of Aram Amos 9:7 ; קִ֫ירָה as place of exile 1:5 ; 2Kin 16:9 ( ᵐ5 τὴν πόλιν ); קִיר as people in Assyrian army Isa 22:6 ( 22:5 see I. קִיר near the end). — Location dubious, see conspectus of older views Dr Amos 1:5 ; plausible is some tribe in Southern Babylonia, east of Tigris Wkl AT Unters 178 , compare Hal REJ xi. 60 ; — WMM Hast. DB KIB everywhere strike out, or emend קוֺעַ , but see I. קִיר 3 above קֵירֹס = קֵרֹס
